messages:
Jen H: Hey team — I pushed a small follow-up to address the inline comments from yesterday. PTAL when you have a minute. I added a unit test for the shard fallback and fixed the off-by-one in allocator rotation.

Omar P: Awesome, thanks. Which test command should I run locally?

Jen H: `./scripts/test -run TestShardFallback -v` — CI should be green but it flakes locally for me once in a while. I added a short note in the PR description about the flake and a reproducible snippet.

CI Bot: Build succeeded on commit abc123 (linux, go1.21) :white_check_mark:

Kevin L: Looks good. A couple small nits — can you add a one-line comment explaining why we use jitter=5ms? Otherwise LGTM.

Jen H: Added the comment and pushed a tiny follow-up (force push). Also moved the assertion to before the goroutine spawn to avoid the race.

Tom R: Quick Q: do we want to backport this to release-2.3? It's small but touches allocator behavior.

Jen H: I think yes — I will open a cherry-pick PR once this merges. If someone on call can merge after CI, I'll queue it for the 09:00 canary slot.

Maya S: I can merge after lunch if nothing else blocks.

Omar P: PTAL @Kevin L @Maya S — trying to get two eyes so we can move to canary.

Kevin L: LGTM, merging when CI stays green.

CI Bot: All checks passing on latest push :white_check_mark:

Jen H: Thanks everyone :raised_hands: tagging release team that we'll do a backport once merged and will post the cherry-pick link here.
